say:1:1541120001:1.text: Tuttleton was the first to collapse after the God of Harvest's fall. Now it's just rubble. Halia's still standing, but barely. Folks are starving. The city's hanging on by a thread.
say:1:1541120001:1.source_cn: 蒙受丰饶神神恩的图塔镇已化作一片废墟，如今的呼临也饿殍...

say:2:1541120002:1.text: Looking at Halia now, I can't help but think of what it used to be...
say:2:1541120002:1.source_cn: 看着现在的呼临城，总让我回想起它从前的样子……

say:3:1541120003:1.source_cn: 从前的呼临城，是什么样子？

say:4:1541120004:1.text: Before the god's fall, Halia was prospering. A city where people lived in peace.
say:4:1541120004:1.source_cn: 神堕之前，呼临是一座和谐的城邦，人人安居乐业。

say:6:1541120005:1.text: Four, maybe five years back, when I first came here, the streets were packed with stalls and laughter. Kids running about, vendors shouting over each other.
say:6:1541120005:1.source_cn: 大约四五年前，我第一次来到这座城邦时，街头尽是热闹的市...

say:7:1541120006:1.text: On the square, minstrels from far-off lands played songs in tongues I'd never heard. When night came, the crowds only grew thicker.
say:7:1541120006:1.source_cn: 广场上也常有来自异乡的吟游诗人，唱着不同语言的歌谣。夜...

say:8:1541120007:1.text: Even though the city sat close to the Taothos Rift and travel wasn't easy, merchants and scholars still made the trip.
say:8:1541120007:1.source_cn: 尽管呼临城距离塔欧妥斯深壑很近，交通不算便利，却也有许...

say:9:1541120008:1.text: If the god hadn't fallen... Halia might have rivaled Tuttleton in its prime.
say:9:1541120008:1.source_cn: 若是没有神堕……假以时日，呼临的名气或许可以与图塔镇比肩。

choice_prompt:10:1541120008.text: If the god hadn't fallen... Halia might have rivaled Tuttleton in its prime.
choice_prompt:10:1541120008.source_cn: 若是没有神堕……假以时日，呼临的名气或许可以与图塔镇比肩。

say:11:1541120009:1.text: Like I said before, Tuttleton was the stronghold of the God of Harvest's worship. That Harvest Altar, battered by disaster yet still standing, is proof enough.
say:11:1541120009:1.source_cn: 如我所说，图塔镇曾是信仰丰饶神最虔诚的所在，那遭受灾难...

say:12:1541120010:1.text: Before the god's fall, Tuttleton was all golden fields and sunshine. The wheat grew tall and bright, and just looking at it could brighten your mood.
say:12:1541120010:1.source_cn: 神堕前的图塔镇，麦田沐浴着阳光，结出金黄色的、令人心生...

say:13:1541120011:1.text: Everyone believed the god's blessings would never leave this land. They were sure his love would always protect them.
say:13:1541120011:1.source_cn: 所有人都相信，丰饶神的慈爱会永远眷顾他们，眷顾这片大地。

say:14:1541120012:1.text: But no one expected the God of Harvest to waste away into skin and bone...
say:14:1541120012:1.source_cn: 可是谁又能想到，象征丰收的神明有一天会形销骨立……

say:16:1541120013:1.text: So he didn't always look like that?
say:16:1541120013:1.source_cn: 丰饶神，以前不是我们看到的那副样子吗？

say:17:1541120014:1.text: When he appeared at the Harvest Altar, I thought he was just another starving refugee.
say:17:1541120014:1.source_cn: 他降临在丰饶祭坛的时候，我还以为又看到了一位饥民。

say:18:1541120015:1.text: How could a god who brings abundance to mortals look so hollowed out?
say:18:1541120015:1.source_cn: 能为凡人带来丰收的神明，怎么会形如枯槁？

say:19:1541120016:1.text: The stories his followers passed down spoke of a powerful, towering god. They said he rode down from the sky on his mount, blessing the soil and calling down rain to nourish the crops.
say:19:1541120016:1.source_cn: 在他信徒之中流传的关于他的描述，大多说他身躯健硕伟岸，...

say:20:1541120017:1.text: Back then, before he fell, they praised him with every kind word they could think of.
say:20:1541120017:1.source_cn: 在他尚未堕落之时，他的信徒愿将一切溢美之词用于他的身上。

say:21:1541120018:1.text: A god has the power to protect everything. But when he falls, that same power can also destroy.
say:21:1541120018:1.source_cn: 只可惜……神拥有庇护一切的力量，但当堕落来袭，神力也可...

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 图塔镇以前是什么样的？

choice:10:1:2.text: Tuttleton was even greater than Halia?
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 很难想象那片废墟曾经比呼临更辉煌……
choice:10:1:2.male: Tuttleton was even greater than Halia?
choice:10:1:2.female: Tuttleton was even greater than Halia?
